caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed circular object that resembles a piece of jewelry or ornament, positioned against a plain, off-white or beige background. The object consists of a large gold-colored circular frame with a series of smaller circular loops and gold beads evenly spaced around its outer edge. Inside the frame, there is a second, smaller dark circular center filled with what appear to be faceted red-purple gemstones arranged in a ring, with a central bluish accent at the very core. The composition is minimalistic, with all visual focus on the detailed circular ornament, and there are no other objects or decorative elements present on the background. The word "White" is handwritten in small script at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Garnet Earring
